Revenue in the Aerospace segment rose on higher deliveries. Gulfstream delivered 30 aircraft in the quarter, of which 25 were large-cabin aircraft, including three test models.

This compares with 20 aircraft delivered in the year-ago quarter, of which 16 were large cabin.
